name: Face Wash | Chando Naturals Charcoal Blackheads Control Face Wash 100ml Daily Cleanser for Oily and Combination Skin
description:
Achieve a deep pore detox with Chando Naturals Charcoal Blackheads Control Face Wash. Infused with activated charcoal, this powerful yet gentle cleanser draws out dirt, oil, and toxins from deep within the pores. It unclogs pores, helps reduce blackheads, and prevents their recurrence while maintaining skin balance. With mild exfoliating action, it smooths texture and controls excess shine without over-drying. Ideal for oily, combination, and acne-prone skin, it leaves your complexion fresh, clear, and rejuvenated.Key Features:
 Size: 100ml tube
 Infused with activated charcoal for deep detox
 Removes blackheads, dirt, oil, and impurities
 Mild exfoliating action for smoother skin
 Controls excess oil and shine effectively
 Suitable for oily, combination, and acne-prone skinHow to Use:
 Wet face with water
 Apply a small amount of face wash and lather
 Massage gently onto face in circular motions
 Rinse thoroughly and pat dry
 Use twice daily for best resultsIngredients:
Activated charcoal, Aqua, Glycerin, Mild exfoliating agents, Natural cleansing componentsSafety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes; rinse immediately if contact occurs
 Discontinue use if irritation develops
 Keep out of reach of children
